record.name: Notion
record.one_liner: Connected workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and project management with a powerful API and MCP server.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free Notion account and immediately create personal access tokens or OAuth integrations in the Developer portal.
record.api_note: The REST API covers pages, databases, data sources, views, comments, user profiles, file uploads, and content queries.

evidence.quote: Internal connections use a static credential called an internal connection API token, personal access tokens use a user-scoped static token, and OAuth integrations and public integrations use the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
You need a Notion account and a terminal.
Send requests over HTTPS to https://api.notion.com.
Notion MCP is a remote MCP server hosted by Notion.
